reconstructed_episode_premise: After storm damage forces a civic theater to close its interior, the staff, city official, performers, and merchants must preserve safety, wages, public accountability, and a viable performance by shifting the event outdoors without pretending the building problem is solved.
major_threads: Building safety: ceiling crack -> nonstandard wiring -> historical repair evidence -> limited-use/closed-interior decision.
Funding and labor: same-day subsidy deadline and unpaid temporary labor -> revised outdoor-operation proposal -> conditional continuation, not full financial closure.
Community/social ecology: merchant support conflicts with traffic/business costs -> explicit time/space conditions -> jointly managed outdoor-performance rules.
Document/accountability: suspicious old repair records and signature mismatch -> evidence preservation -> bounded public disclosure without premature blame.
Yunseo family conflict: father appears in historical work records -> conflict-of-interest disclosure and procedural safeguards; responsibility remains unresolved.
Performance survival: indoor reopening abandoned -> mobile equipment + negotiated public-space operation -> actual outdoor performance.

reconstructed_sequence_functions.function: Detect safety defect, halt rehearsal, establish evidence-first safety rule and Yunseo's possible conflict of interest.
Make the financial/labor deadline concrete and shift Minho's goal from opening the building to preserving people/work.
Establish historical/non-storm electrical risk, suspicious documents, and controlled evidence custody.
Show mixed community support and convert it into conditional spatial/time constraints for an outdoor alternative.
Deepen historical evidence and convert Yunseo–Taekyung and Yunseo–Minho relationships toward procedural trust.
Materialize outdoor-performance feasibility through portable equipment and Jiwoo–Sookyung negotiated cooperation.
Formalize responsibility boundaries and submit the revised funding/labor operating proposal before deadline.
Verify wiring/document evidence further, separate fact from accusation, and define limited-use zones without reopening the building.
Execute the outdoor performance under live crowd/business pressure, receive conditional funding response, and end with long-horizon problems explicitly open.
